input.instruction: Complete a theft-intake handoff. The listed items are short noun labels rather than free-form summaries. Ready follows H12 intake prerequisites, not possession of receipts or a final coverage decision. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: Someone stole my work bag from the cafe at 9 Willow Square, Larkport, US on October 5, 2026. My laptop and headphones were in it.
When you say your laptop, do you own it, or is it supplied by an employer?
The laptop belongs to my employer. I bought and own the headphones and the bag. I said my laptop because I use it every day.
Should the incident report still describe all three items and distinguish ownership?
Yes. Do not leave the laptop out of the incident description, but do not say I own it. My employer is handling its own equipment report.
Do you have values, and which contact should staff use?
No exact values yet. Contact kai.moss@post.example. Please prepare the theft intake now; I will send receipts later.

customer_owned_items.description: Unordered item names explicitly stated to be owned by the customer; use the short nouns from the chat.

employer_owned_items.description: Unordered item names explicitly stated to be owned solely by the employer; use short nouns from the chat.

include_employer_item_in_incident.description: Whether customer asks to retain employer property in the incident description without claiming personal ownership.

exact_total_value.description: Exact documented total value in USD; null if unknown, not zero.
